items.title: Chinese memory chipmaker CXMT booms in IPO. Does US memory stand a chance?
items.summary: China's biggest memory chipmaker, ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT), is surging in its IPO on the Shanghai Stock Exchange. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley explains what investors should know about emerging Chinese competition in the tech space.

items.title: Applied Materials Stock Keeps Winning Upgrades: Is Michael Burry Dead Wrong to Short This Semiconductor Gem?
items.summary: Michael Burry has placed a targeted short against Applied Materials, but Wall Street analysts keep piling on upgrades as memory chip demand surges. Find out whether the Big Short legend has spotted a crack in the cycle or left a critical blind spot exposed.

items.title: CXMT, Sandisk, ASML, SpaceX, D-Wave Quantum, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: FEATURE  Chip stocks were selling off and weighing on major indexes following reports that a state-backed Chinese company has begun mass producing chip-making machines.  Those same semiconductor companies, and many artificial-intelligence names, also were under pressure Monday after Chinese memory chip maker ChangXin Memory Technologies ’(CXMT) massive trading debut.

items.summary: Shares of major chipmakers fell sharply on Monday after reports that a state-backed Chinese firm has begun mass-producing domestic deep ultraviolet (DUV) lithography machines. items.title: Chip Stocks Sink on China Competition Concerns, Erasing Early Gains
items.summary: The S&P 500 and the Nasdaq Composite reversed gains, wavering near the flatline after opening higher.  The PHLX Semiconductor Index was down 4.3% after opening higher.  Nvidia, AMD, Micron, and ASML are some of the chip maker stocks dragging the semi index and the broader market lower, thanks to the group's heavy impact on the major indexes.
